title: Plan Money Brought Into a Circle Dues Settlement
content:
Money the member owes on the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans plan the profile holds is brought
into the same settlement as the dues on a Northbeam Circle Membership. Which amount is brought in follows
the standing of that plan, the premium entries on it and the deductible standing on it.

## The readings

1. Where that plan stands active or in claim hold and the premium charged on it in the twelve months
   ending on the handling day is above the premium paid on it in that window, the shortfall between the
   two is brought in.
2. Where that plan stands active or in claim hold, no such shortfall stands and a deductible stands
   unsettled on it, that unsettled deductible is brought in.
3. Where neither of those holds, nothing is brought in for the plan, and 0.00 goes into the settlement on
   this account.

## Points of judgement

*What counts as a shortfall?* The premium charged on the plan in the twelve months ending on the handling
day taken against the premium paid on it in that same window, where the charges are the greater. Where the
premium paid equals or exceeds the premium charged in that window, no shortfall stands and the second
reading is the one to take.

*Does a plan in claim hold count?* Yes. A plan standing in a claim hold is read the same way as one
standing active for this purpose. A plan standing in any other way falls to the third reading whatever the
premium ledger and the deductible show.

*Can both a shortfall and a deductible be brought in together?* No. The second reading turns on no
shortfall standing, so at most one amount is brought in for the plan.

## Hypothetical figures

A plan standing active with 240.00 of premium charged and 180.00 of premium paid in the twelve months
brings in the shortfall of 60.00, and a deductible of 100.00 standing unsettled on the same plan is not
brought in as well. The same plan with 240.00 charged and 240.00 paid brings in the unsettled deductible of
100.00 instead. A plan standing expired with the same figures brings in nothing. A plan standing active with nothing
charged, nothing paid and no deductible unsettled brings in nothing as well.
